content.text:
The drawing shows an ynamide: a phenyl ring attached to a CH2, which is attached to an alkyne, whose far carbon is bonded to N. The nitrogen carries a methyl group and a tosyl group.

Reading it region by region:
- Benzene ring: c1ccccc1.
- Benzylic CH2 joins the ring to the alkyne.
- Alkyne: C#C, ending at N.
- Nitrogen: substituents are Me and Ts (p-toluenesulfonyl, S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C)cc1).

SMILES: CN(C#CCc1ccccc1)S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C)cc1
